name: Example EnergyPlus Rotated Building Project
description: Building performance simulation with the EnergyPlus backend, based on the FZK-Haus IFC, with the building rotated 180 degrees clockwise. Useful for testing orientation-dependent results such as solar gains. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e4_simple_rotated_project_energyplus.py. Identical to the simple EnergyPlus example, but with building_rotation_overwrite set to 180 degrees. Requires a working EnergyPlus installation with ep_install_path set correctly (see Advanced Settings) since run_full_simulation is enabled.
